labor-and-pla: Negotiated the PLA and mobilized unions once the intensive phase began. About 50 supporters and 20 speakers at the May City Council meeting, repeated on hearing night.
coalition-building: About four months in a support capacity before the intensive phase, focused on business and union education.
hearing-night: Matched the May council turnout on public hearing night: union supporters in the room and at the podium.
patch-through-calls: Patch-through calls to back up the hearing turnout. They didn't do much.
direct-mail-and-newspaper-ads: Two rounds of mail to all of Fredericksburg.
earned-media-local: An extensive letters-to-the-editor campaign alongside a broader media push.
client-counsel: RenUSA ran the intensive phase alongside the developer. The other consultants took a back seat, perhaps too far back.
